reason: A dsh plugin for coordinating multi-agent software development workflows, with bundled skill and agent deployment plus a management panel.

summaries.zh: 用于在 dsh 中编排多智能体软件开发流程，并部署技能与专家代理提示词的插件。
summaries.en: A dsh plugin for orchestrating multi-agent software development workflows and deploying bundled skills and specialist agent prompts.

capabilities: Orchestrates multiple specialist AI agents for software development workflows
Deploys bundled skills and agent prompt files to configured local directories
Provides a bilingual management panel for skills, agents, and invocation phrases
Coordinates planning, implementation, testing, and code review stages
